summary: Two-phase bit-packed indexed texture decoder. Phase 1 (guarded on this+0x8 == 3) unpacks 4-bit, 2-bit or 1-bit planar fields from a packed source buffer into one byte per pixel, then stores this+0x9 = 8 and the processed pixel count into this+0x4. Phase 2 (guarded on this+0x9 == 8) looks each byte up in an RGB palette (base a3, 2 bytes stride per index) writing RGB output, or RGB plus an alpha byte sourced from secondary table a4 when a4 is non-zero. Output format state is recorded in this+0x8 (6=RGBA / 2=RGB), this+0xA (4 / 3 bytes per pixel) and this+0xB (32 / 24 stride), with the final output byte count written to this+0x4.

local_names.this: texture-format state object carrying pixel count, phase and bit-depth bytes
local_names.a2: destination buffer for unpacked / decompressed output
local_names.a3: RGB palette base for color lookup
local_names.a4: optional alpha table; non-zero selects RGBA output path
local_names.a5: alpha threshold: palette index below it reads alpha byte, otherwise -1

operations.description: Enter the bit-unpack phase only when this+0x8 == 3 (phase marker); otherwise the whole body is skipped

When this+0x9 < 8, dispatch on bit depth: 4-bit branch (this+0x9 == 4) shifts nibbles out of the packed buffer (offset a2 + (count-1)/2) and writes one byte per pixel, walking the destination backwards
2-bit branch (this+0x9 == 2) shifts 2-bit fields out of the packed buffer (offset a2 + (count-1)/4), writing one byte per pixel
1-bit branch (this+0x9 == 1) shifts single bits out of the packed buffer (offset a2 + (count-1)/8), writing one byte per pixel
After any unpack branch: this+0x9 set to 8, this+0xB set to 8, and this+0x4 set to the pixel count (a1[1] = result)
Color-lookup phase entered only when this+0x9 == 8 (the state byte set at the end of unpacking)
RGBA path (a4 non-zero): per pixel, index below a5 reads an alpha byte from table a4, otherwise writes -1; RGB triple read from the a3 palette at 2*index stride; output advances 4 bytes per pixel
RGB path (a4 zero): per pixel, three palette bytes read from a3 at 2*index stride; output advances 3 bytes per pixel
Record output format: RGBA path sets this+0xB = 32, this+0x8 = 6, this+0xA = 4; RGB path sets this+0xB = 24, this+0x8 = 2, this+0xA = 3; both set this+0x9 = 8 and this+0x4 = output byte count
Return the pixel count; invoked by sub_51389E (0051389e) as part of the indexed-texture decode path

clean_pseudocode: if (depth == 4) for each pixel: out[i] = (src >> shift4) & 0xF; shift4 advances 4 bits per pixel across nibble pairs;
else if (depth == 2) for each pixel: out[i] = (src >> shift2) & 3; shift2 advances 2 bits per pixel;
else for each pixel: out[i] = (src >> shift1) & 1; shift1 advances 1 bit per pixel;
